code:
use default

let n = 13

let sorted = (1::n)
    |> map(i => "{i}")
    |> sort((a, b) => a <> b)
    |> map(int.parse)
    |> collect_list()

write_line(sorted |> join(", "))

use default

let n = 13

let sorted = (1::n)
    |> map(i => "{i}")
    |> sort((a, b) => a <> b)
    |> map(int.parse)
    |> collect_list()

write_line(sorted |> join(", "))
